work.title: English 10: Help me learn your names!
work.note: Dad's night. Canvas video: full name twice + something you are awesome at. 5 points.

work.title: English 10: Summer Narrative Comic Strip
work.note: In class Tuesday. Official Canvas due Thursday 11:59pm. 10 points, submitting on paper. We completed this on paper during class time. If you were absent, see me for the directions! Illustration (5 pts): Illustrations should be included in every square. They should be detailed and completed in color. No more than 2 boxes should be words-only. Writing (5 pts): On the back, you should turn your comic into a short narrative. This should be a full paragraph (at least 5 sentences) and describe the events illustrated in your comic. Ratings: 5 Exceeds / 4 Mastery / 3 Near / 2 Below / 1 No Evidence.
